name: Synchronize
author: Zenthimegal
description: Fly above the cube portal as the mini ship between the spike at 13.7%. Navigate through the following gameplay as the mini ship without touching any portals until 16% where you can move to the floor and stay there after your icon passes the saw. Move up off the floor at 72.9% and play through the following gameplay as the mini ship until 76.8% where you can hold into the ball portal near the ceiling. Play through the levels gameplay while being mini until 92% when you enter a size portal. Play the level normally from there.
